scope: Read-only saved startup AVC, focused shipped secure-element DT_NEEDED chain and LLVM inspection. No phone/source/build/process operations. No engine installation, no full artifact scan.
method: LLVM dynamic tables, relocations and focused AArch64 disassembly plus current source policy/API inspection. Not REA decompilation; unavailable Ghidra/IDA backends not retried.

limits: AVC identifies the property area, not exact requested key or call stack.
Global Permissive means AVC does not prove getter actually returned failure.
No Enforcing eSE/APDU behavior was observed in this scope.

artifact_chain.role: Default backend; NEEDED libminkdescriptor.so/libminksocket_vendor.so/libdmabufheap.so plus GPTEE/common libraries. This is a Mink backend, not proof of MediaTek platform use.
Running-qteeconnector backend; NEEDED libQTEEConnector_vendor.so/vendor.qti.hardware.qteeconnector@1.0.so plus GPTEE/common libraries.

artifact_chain.limit: Executable is present; process registration/running state was not established here.

exact_getter.comparison: Result is compared to the exact seven-byte string running at0x2138–0x2148.
exact_getter.running_case: At0x2154–0x2158 pointer0x7358 is updated to string GPQTEEC at0x16c2.
exact_getter.missing_denied_or_other_value: Branches to cleanup at0x215c; default pointer remains GPMTEEC (initial .data VA0x7358/file0x6358 contains pointer0x152a). Returns at0x219c without wait, retry loop, sleep or property-failure abort.
exact_getter.backend_use: Later code loads selected pointer0x7358 at0x3228/0x3244, formats lib%s%s.so (format VA0x1795, suffix _vendor VA0x16ca), then dlopen at0x32cc. Both resulting backend files exist.
exact_getter.limits: This establishes static fallback selection, not that GPM backend succeeds under Enforcing or that qteeconnector running state currently equals/does not equal running. Other unrelated C++ abort sites are not property-failure behavior.

qtee_bounded_search.limits: Recursive regular decodable files<=500KB under each output etc/init or etc/vintf.
qtee_bounded_search.matches: Only an init.qcom.rc comment about a QTEEConnector app directory; no service declaration or VINTF registration match containing qteeconnector.
qtee_bounded_search.do_not_infer: Do not say executable/service is absent: the executable is present, and loading via other configuration or constructed names is not excluded.

policy_contract.fact: init.svc. prefix maps init_service_status_private_prop; no exact qteeconnector-hal-1-0 mapping observed in inspected merged sources.
system_internal_prop enforces neverallow {domain -coredomain} type:file no_rw_file_perms under normal Treble property gates.
Only init can set private/public init-service-status properties.
init_service_status_prop is a separate public restricted type; it is not the private type in this AVC.
Existing QTEEConnector/eSE-power-manager HAL client contracts and vendor_ese_prop reads. No existing private init state API.

decision.immediate: Retain the denial for this candidate; do not grant init_service_status_private_prop reads and do not disable Treble neverallow/export platform private types.
decision.risk: No unconditional startup wait/abort established; failure/empty value changes backend choice. This is a real conditional eSE behavior risk, not proof it is harmless.
decision.future_validation: When authorized Enforcing validation reaches eSE/APDU/OMAPI, test actual secure-element initialization and session operations. Basic NFC tag reading does not validate eSE sessions.
decision.if_problem_reproduces: Establish actual backend used and authoritative qteeconnector service lifecycle first. A deliberate exact exported status API or compatible source-level backend selection can then be assessed; do not retype the whole init.svc namespace or infer a fix from the AVC alone.
